question: Can predicting residual unmatched inventory improve downside against deterministic and no-trade controls?

selection.criterion: Mean validation Brier; simplicity within 0.002 tolerance

stopping_condition: One frozen dataset, four fits, two 100-group challenges. No retuning after challenge results.
limitations: Synthetic hypothetical fills; risk probability is not real execution calibration.
Residual unequal filled shares is not inverse full completion and not guaranteed loss severity.
Seven training families rotate seed parity; six-family challenge adds a separately reported generator-distribution shift.
No comparison to legacy completion gates trained on a different dataset; cross-target policy comparison remains later work.
amendment_reason: Reproduction of opened earlier losses found initial-decision sampling excluded later first-admitted trades. Initial build cancelled at 384/1001; no training or final challenge began.
